estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap over the episodes present in the window set, models FIXED, B 2000, seed 0 (draws identical to taniteval.ci._draws): answers 'another draw of EPISODES' only; NOT another training run (single training seed), NOT another inference run (the sampler seed is fixed per window; arm N2 reports the draw-to-draw floor)

KA.what: CPU native (arm N, per-window sampler seed, fp32 trunk) vs the banked GPU `os` (global sequential sampler stream, bf16 trunk) on the S2 slots: BIT-IDENTITY IS IMPOSSIBLE, so this is a statistical agreement check against the brief's 0.05 m bar, read against the banked inference floor.
KA.reading: The 0.05 m bar is applied AS WRITTEN (bar_exceeded). A CPU-vs-GPU mean difference inside the banked floor is what a faithful re-roll looks like; the Master Mind reads an exceedance against that floor.

KB.what: displacement of the S2 plan from native N (mean over the 4 slots of the L2 distance, m).  Forcing the head's OWN argmax class must move the plan LESS than forcing F_slow (proves the force reaches the planner and that the shift is not sampler noise, N2 = another draw).

F1.assumption: CI half-width ~ 1/sqrt(n_windows); the point estimate stays; ESTIMATED, not measured

F_slow.assumption: CI half-width ~ 1/sqrt(n_windows); the point estimate stays; ESTIMATED, not measured

ARITHMETIC_E1_if_S2A_u_S2B_took_the_Fslo.LABEL: ARITHMETIC, NOT A RESULT.  SHIFT form: each full set's banked d is moved by the rolled subsample's mean (ADE_F_slow - ADE_N), CPU vs CPU, and the E1 cell is re-read on the SAME draws.  The CI is conditional on that shift being exact for the unrolled windows.
